minutes_text:
Arts Commission

  Inglewood, California
  May 27, 2026

A meeting of the Inglewood Arts Commission convened on May 27, 2026. Chairman
Jacques Lesure called the meeting to order at 6:30 p.m., followed by the flag salute.

Ramara Rubin announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:
   Commissioner Aletha Metcalf, District No. 1 (Arrived at
  6:33 p.m.)
   Commissioner Olivia Alvitre, District No. 2
   Commissioner Phyllis Battle, District No. 3
   Commissioner Anya Christiansen, District No. 4
   Chairman Jacques Lesure, Commissioner at Large
  City Personnel present were as follows:
   Kerri Arroyo  Library Director
   Ramara Rubin  Secretary

PUBLIC COMMENTS. None

MINUTES. Commissioner Christiansen moved, and Commissioner Alvitre seconded, that
the minutes for the Arts Commission meeting held on April 15, 2026 be approved.
The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
Ayes: Commissioners Alvitre, Battle, Christiansen and
Lesure
Noes: None
Abstained: Commissioner Battle

DISCUSSION.
  a. Shelby J., a representative from the Project Development Team for the Kali
  Hotel, presented an update on the Kali Hotel project, including its location
  and current progress. Shelby discussed the integration of art into the hotel’s
  design, highlighted collaborations with local Inglewood artists, and noted that
  agreements with the selected artists are expected to be finalized within the
  next six to eight weeks.
   Arts Commission

 VERBAL REPORTS-Public Art‐Related Projects.
  a. Kayla S. of Coloured Art Studio shared information about the organization's
  mission and proposed a partnership with Inglewood Open Studios and the
  Inglewood Public Library to host a Family Art Festival on August 8, 2026. The
  proposal included having the Mobile Library at the event to promote reading
  and literacy.
  b. Allen F., co-founder of Zeal Cooperative, presented the Market Street Cultural
  District proposal for Downtown Inglewood, including a feasibility study, a
  public art pilot, and funding needs. He also shared that the Downtown
  Inglewood Association has been established with a board and executive
  committee. Allen requested $125,000 to support planning efforts and public
  art activation.
  It was moved by Commissioner Alvitre and seconded by Commissioner Metcalf to
  approve $125,000 in funding for the Market Street Cultural District.
  Ayes: Commissioners Metcalf, Alvitre, Battle,
  Christiansen and Lesure
  Noes: None
  c. Library Director, Kerri Arroyo informed the commission about the
  procurement process and the need for a formal bid for amounts over
  $100,000.
  d. Allen F., agreed to follow up with a revised proposal for the next meeting.
  e. Library Director Kerri Arroyo provided an update on Inglewood Public
  Library’s “Booked on Art” Summer Reading Program, highlighting interactive
  programs such as the LA Music Center’s Boxtales Theatre Group and the
  availability of free museum tickets as incentives. Kerri emphasized the
  importance of connecting art and literacy throughout library programming.
  f. Kerri Arroyo presented the public art fund balance to show an uncommitted
  balance of $1,223,000, highlighting active contracts and in-process projects.
  Kerri mentioned the Crenshaw-Imperial Branch public art installation and
  public art consultant contracts are pending.
PUBLIC REMARKS.
  a. Camille D. and Romel C., representatives of Party in My Living Room event
  company, proposed a festival to celebrate the City of Inglewood’s 119th
  Anniversary bringing together all generations, featuring live performances,
  gaming stations, and community activities.
COMMISSIONERS’ COMMENTS/INITIATIVES/ART CALENDAR.
  a. Chairman Lesure shared a personal story about the Lavender Blue jazz
  sessions and the release of his album, Jacques Lesure Live at Lavender Blue.
  b. Kerri Arroyo announced Tommy the Turtle’s visit to Inglewood City Hall and
  the Crenshaw-Imperial Branch on Friday, May 30, 2026.
  c. The commission discussed next month’s meeting logistics.
 It was moved by Commissioner Battle and seconded by Commissioner Christiansen that
Commissioner Metcalf be elected as Chair pro tempore in the absence of Chairman Lesure
for the next meeting on Wednesday, June 17, 2026 at 6:30 p.m.
Ayes: Commissioners Metcalf, Alvitre, Battle, Christiansen and Lesure
Noes: None
  d. Next Arts Commission Meeting: Wednesday, June 17, 2026 at 6:30 p.m.
There being no further business to be presented, Chairman Lesure declared the meeting
adjourned at 7:26 p.m.
